content_of_post_to_comment: Writers, is an author’s note blatantly stating “no AI was used in making this book” now an expectation?? It feels like giving AI too much power. Like admitting that use of AI is now the norm and you have to explicitly state when you don’t use it. How do y’all feel?
comment: Perhaps the more interesting shift is that authors are being asked to prove human authorship rather than readers being invited to judge the quality of the work. That changes the nature of trust.
